budget_capped_allocation.reason: The requested allocation needs 5097 worlds; this is the largest balanced allocation supplied by the separately computed <=150-unit packing model.

dependence.assumption: T23 marginal SD used for each contrast; no covariance invented
dependence.note: The independent Monte Carlo is diagnostic only; the allocation rests on the dependence-robust bound.

familywise_null.claim: Holm at alpha .05 strongly controls family-wise false rejection at <=.05 under valid marginal p-values, including composite nulls; no cross-contrast independence is needed.

limitations: T23 is a different controller comparison; its marginal variance is a planning proxy. Incremental D+O-D variance and covariance with D+O-B8 are unobserved. Actual guards, fault rules, and point bars can only reduce complete-controller GO probability.

point_bar_disclosure.at_true40: Under symmetric continuous estimation error this point bar has an asymptotic 0.5 pass ceiling; no sample size establishes >=.80 full-GO power while retaining it.
point_bar_disclosure.prospective_correction_required_for_full: Replace the point bar in a sibling pre-data amendment with a superiority-inference rule (for example Holm-rejected D+O-B8 >0 plus a prospectively chosen effect threshold strictly below +40), or define the .80 target as superiority-only. Do not represent this sizing as full-GO power under the retained point bar.

rule.sizing_sufficient_event: sharp Fréchet lower bound for Holm rejection over arbitrary cross-contrast dependence
